svg.title: What a job switch resets and what it keeps
svg.desc: Switching to any other job in the Job and sync panel, even one in the same role, happens at once with no confirmation, and changes only the open tab's selections; the other tab keeps its own job. Kept when the new job can use it (a stat the new job has under the same name; a slot it wears), else reset to the new job's defaults. How the math works: the Piece stats substats (Critical Hit, then speed; both stay or both reset) and the Piece stats slot (head, only if the new job lacks the slot). Gear browser: the slot (any slot) and the sort (item level, high first; a sort by name, level, item level or a kept stat stays). Held to the new job's level cap, so lowered only if above it (for example 90 becomes 80 for Blue Mage): the synced level and the Gear browser's equip level filter. Kept: the sync cap and sync switch, the Gear browser's Gear categories boxes and market board switch, its expansion and item level filters and search text, the Piece stats item level, the GCD and Substat tiers sub-tabs' own boxes (not saved) and the open tab. Not changed: the other tab's job and settings; a sheet on the Sheets tab has no panel, its job is set when it is made.
